overview.bbobDesc: Blazing‑fast BBCode parser. Transforms to AST, then to HTML, React, or Vue.

experience.title: Places I've helped build.
experience.hodl: Reimagined frontend infrastructure on top of Next.js — faster builds, cleaner data layer, a design system that scales with the team.
experience.cube: Helped built the UI Kit that backs Cube's SaaS, created JSON to SQL tokenizer and visualizer.
experience.muse: Improved Musescore & Ultimate Guitar — tablature rendering & BBCode pipelines from seconds to 15 ms.
experience.skyeng: Helped to built learner‑facing product surfaces for CIS largest online English school..
experience.medialooks: Designed single‑page applications for streaming and media‑production tooling.

crafts.title: A few things I've made.
crafts.bbobP1: A JavaScript library for parsing BBCode. Converts bbcode → AST → React. Renders tablature at ultimate‑guitar.com with cord tooltips and two‑column printing that keeps chords and verses aligned.
crafts.bbobP2: Later adopted by musescore.com for comments & posts after the PHP pipeline OOM'd at ~1 GB. Moving rendering to the client took page‑wide BBCode from seconds to 15 ms.
crafts.bnetP1: As part of R&D, I reverse‑engineered (via Wireshark) and implemented the Battle.net protocol for Warcraft 3 in Node.js. Some native C libraries are wired in via node‑ffi.
crafts.bnetP2: A study in binary protocols, packet framing, and keeping a long‑running Node process honest.

support.lede: Most of what I build is open source. If BBob saved your team an afternoon, or a post helped you debug at 2 AM, a small tip keeps the lights on for the next thing.
support.note: double‑check the network before sending. USDT on TRC‑20 is not the same as USDT on ERC‑20 — sending to the wrong chain loses the funds. If you're unsure, ping me on Telegram first.
